summary_en: soispoke submitted an EIP for keyed nonces in frame transactions, letting one EIP-8141 sender run several independent nonce sequences in parallel for trustless privacy protocols. nero_eth noted that with frame transactions and 2D nonces, private withdrawals can pay fees from the withdrawal itself with no third party relayer. The EIP-8037 fixed CPSB change and the EIP-8130 payer signature replay fix both merged.
